name: dev-kit
description: Vito's personal Claude Code skill collection. 12 skills: ship (adaptive dev SOP — size S/M/L → blindspot→grill→plan→code→review→收盘), debrief (收盘 sedimentation), dispatch (outsource to cheap headless engines), blindspot (unknown-unknowns territory briefing), advanced-plan, worktree, audit-context, exa-code, handoff, html-doc, skill-atlas, ccobs (SQLite observability ledger over session transcripts). 5 subagents: ship-tester, ship-analyst, general-skills-executor, advisor (mid-task strategic guidance / second opinion from a stronger model), code-search. PreToolUse skill-guard redirects noisy inline skill usage to the right subagent.
